test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 4% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (3000 × 4 × 2) / 100

⇒ SI = 24000 / 100

⇒ SI = 240

**The simple interest on ₹3000 at 4% per year for 2 years is ₹240.**
